game.name: Super Mario World
game.desc: Mario's first adventure on the SNES, featuring Yoshi and a massive world to explore. One of the greatest platformers ever created with tight controls & brilliant level design.

game.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
game.desc: Explore a vast world of light and dark in this action-adventure classic. Features dungeons, puzzles, and an epic quest to rescue Princess Zelda.

game.name: Chrono Trigger
game.desc: Travel through time to prevent a global catastrophe in this legendary RPG by the dream team of Square. Multiple endings & innovative battle system.

game.name: Donkey Kong Country
game.desc: Pre-rendered 3D graphics brought this platformer to life. Collect bananas and defeat Kremlings across diverse environments.

game.name: Street Fighter II Turbo
game.desc: The definitive home version of the legendary fighting game with turbo speed settings and all playable characters.

game.name: Super Metroid
game.desc: Explore the planet Zebes in this atmospheric masterpiece. Non-linear exploration, tight controls, and an iconic soundtrack define this action classic.

game.name: SimCity
game.desc: Build and manage your own city. Zone residential, commercial, and industrial areas while managing budgets and disasters.

game.name: F-Zero
game.desc: Futuristic high-speed racing with Mode 7 graphics. Four hovercars compete across treacherous courses at breakneck speeds.

game.name: Tetris Attack
game.desc: Swap and match panels in this addictive puzzle game featuring Yoshi and friends. Deceptively simple mechanics with deep competitive play.
